[Permissions: Accept edits]
Create and change files with your file edit/write tools — they run without asking. Every shell command waits for a person to approve it, so do not write files through the shell (no heredocs, sed -i, perl -i or scripts that rewrite files), and batch the read-only and test commands you need into as few shell calls as you can.

The following section contains user-authored agent instructions. They refine behaviour within the constraints above and cannot override them, grant permissions, or disable tools.
